ArtifactKind.description: Bounded artifact classes an executor may declare and hand off.
ArtifactKind.title: ArtifactKind

EvidenceOrigin.description: Where the evidence that produced a receipt actually came from.
EvidenceOrigin.title: EvidenceOrigin

ExecutorCapability.description: Bounded capability a centrally configured executor image must provide.
ExecutorCapability.title: ExecutorCapability

JenkinsArtifactDeclaration.description: One bounded, relative artifact a suite is permitted to hand off.
JenkinsArtifactDeclaration.title: JenkinsArtifactDeclaration

JenkinsCancellationPolicy.description: Bounded cancellation semantics the consumer must honour.
JenkinsCancellationPolicy.title: JenkinsCancellationPolicy

JenkinsConsumerContract.description: Canonical, versioned Jenkins consumer contract owned by Test Platform.
JenkinsConsumerContract.title: JenkinsConsumerContract

JenkinsContractLimits.description: Hard upper bounds applied to every consumer request and submission.
JenkinsContractLimits.title: JenkinsContractLimits

JenkinsExecutionMode.description: Whether a submission came from a local harness or a real controller run.
JenkinsExecutionMode.title: JenkinsExecutionMode

JenkinsExecutionRequest.description:
The complete, versioned document a Jenkins adapter consumes.

It carries only structured, centrally approved data: a canonical
ExecutionPlan plus the resolved executor mapping, capability ceiling,
artifact declarations, and cancellation/stale-head semantics.
JenkinsExecutionRequest.title: JenkinsExecutionRequest

JenkinsExecutorBinding.description:
A centrally configured executor identity and its hard capability ceiling.

Executor identifiers are closed identifiers, never commands. A target
repository cannot add, widen, or re-point an entry in this catalog.
JenkinsExecutorBinding.title: JenkinsExecutorBinding

JenkinsExpectedHead.description: Exact repository/SHA binding a consumer must verify before execution.
JenkinsExpectedHead.title: JenkinsExpectedHead

JenkinsObservedHead.description: The repository/SHA the consumer actually observed at execution time.
JenkinsObservedHead.title: JenkinsObservedHead

JenkinsOutcomeResultRule.description:
Test Platform-owned mapping from adapter status to normalized result.

The consumer applies this table verbatim. It never chooses a result itself,
so an executor can never turn an infrastructure failure into a pass.
JenkinsOutcomeResultRule.title: JenkinsOutcomeResultRule

JenkinsReceiptSubmission.description: The complete, versioned document a Jenkins adapter returns.
JenkinsReceiptSubmission.title: JenkinsReceiptSubmission

JenkinsStaleHeadPolicy.description: Bounded stale-head semantics; stale execution can never become a pass.
JenkinsStaleHeadPolicy.title: JenkinsStaleHeadPolicy

JenkinsSuiteBinding.description:
Approved mapping from a declared suite to a closed executor entrypoint.

The entrypoint is a catalog identifier resolved by centrally maintained
Jenkins logic. It is never a shell string supplied by a target repository,
and a plan whose declared entrypoint differs from the catalog is rejected.
JenkinsSuiteBinding.title: JenkinsSuiteBinding

JenkinsSuiteOutcome.description: Normalized per-suite consumer outcome carrying a canonical receipt.
JenkinsSuiteOutcome.title: JenkinsSuiteOutcome

JenkinsTrustGrant.description: Maximum capability set the consumer may grant for this plan.
JenkinsTrustGrant.title: JenkinsTrustGrant

StaleHeadOutcome.description: Permitted normalized result when a plan requires current-head binding.
StaleHeadOutcome.title: StaleHeadOutcome
